overview: Akshay Classes Fee Management Portal — a premium full-stack SaaS application for managing student fees, payments, and notifications. Built with React, Supabase, and a polished glassmorphism dashboard design.
features: Premium landing page with animated hero, features, stats, testimonials, FAQ, pricing, and contact sections
Role-based authentication for admins and students with protected layouts
Admin dashboard with revenue charts, student management, and notification system
Enhanced student forms with 14+ fields, searchable dropdowns, Indian phone validation, and enrollment code generation
Class and section management system for organizing students
Student credentials modal showing enrollment code after account creation
Student portal with fee overview, UPI/QR payment flow, payment history, and receipt printing
Enrollment code linking flow for students to connect their account on first login
Dark and light mode with persistent theme
